meta.name: english-swe-daily
meta.description: Daily English expression coach for intermediate software engineers. Use this skill whenever the user wants to improve their spoken or written English in a software engineering work context — especially for standups, Slack messages, 1:1s, meetings, giving feedback on code, asking for help, disagreeing politely, or casual small talk with teammates. Trigger this skill when the user says things like "teach me English", "practice English", "how do I say X at work", "daily English", "help me sound more natural", "English for standups", "how should I phrase this in Slack", or any similar request about sounding more natural or professional in English at a tech job. Also trigger when the user gives you a draft message or spoken phrase and asks you to improve it or make it sound more natural.
